title: Scale Randomizer
description: Randomizes the scale of every entity, every minute. Customizable!
body:
This mod randomizes the scale attribute of every mob. By default it happens every 60 seconds but this can be changed by editing the config file. The mod has an option to unlock the scale of the happy ghast, ender dragon and shulkers, be warned this may cause issues.

Inside scale-randomizer.json you will find:
* scaleTimer: how long until scale is randomized in ticks, default 1200
* fullRangeChance: the chance that the random scale will be between 0.0625 and 16, instead of 0.25 and 1.75, default 0.05
* shouldEffectPlayers: if players should have their scale randomized, default true
* uncapScale: if shulkers, happy ghasts and ender dragons should have their scale uncapped, default false
